text:
sam: Hey folks  landing in Boston Tues mid-day. Staying near Chinatown/Downtown Crossing. Looking for quick dumplings or a solid lobster roll spot around 1pm. Any recs that wont eat my whole lunch break?

elaine: If you want dumplings, Gourmet Dumpling House on Tyler St is super fast and cheap. Turnover is quick.

hugo: Neptune Oyster is the lobster roll king but expect a wait. If you're short on time, Row 34 or The Daily Catch (fast counter) are better for speed.

tania: For Taiwanese dumplings try Dumpling Cafe on Harrison  decent and usually quick. Also, Union Oyster House is touristy but fast counter service.

sam: Great, thanks. Any outdoor seating options in case of sun?

elaine: A few benches near the Boston Common edge by Tremont, or a tiny patio at Row 34 if weather's good.

hugo: Quick poll: :dumpling: Gourmet Dumpling (fast dumplings), :lobster: Neptune/Row34 (lobster roll, variable wait), :ramen: Dumpling Cafe/Taiwanese (quick), :green_salad: lighter bowls at Life Alive nearby

elaine: :dumpling:

tania: :ramen:

hugo: :lobster: (but only if you can do wait)

sam: Locking in Gourmet Dumpling House 13:00 Tue unless objections.

ops-bot: calendar: Event created "Chinatown Lunch  Sam + team" Tue 13:00-13:45 provisional. Attendees: sam, elaine, hugo.

sam: Pinned addresses in case anyone wants them: ```Gourmet Dumpling House  52 Tyler St, Boston, MA
Neptune Oyster  63 Salem St, Boston, MA
Row 34  383 Congress St, Boston, MA```

elaine: If anyones arriving early and wants coffee, meet at the lobby at 12:30 and we'll walk over.

tania: Also FYI some streets can be busy with delivery scooters around lunch so give an extra 5 mins.

sam: Perfect, appreciate the recs and the quick poll. See you Tue! :wave:
